The doctor is good, gives good advice, has a gentle touch, and is fun to talk to.
The place is small, but you can park for free at Lotus and walk a short distance. It's easy to find, and there are plenty of food options nearby. They explained the treatment plan and costs clearly and comprehensively. The price is reasonable.

The clinic is located at Maruay Market, next to Lotus Pinklao. When I went, I parked in Lotus.
I had an appointment for teeth cleaning at 10:30 AM, but I didn't get into the examination room until 11:00 AM.
The clinic is clean, the prices are reasonable, and they accept social security insurance. I recommend calling to make an appointment beforehand because it's quite busy and people are constantly coming in.
The clinic will contact you to confirm your appointment one day before.

This is my personal experience: the dentist who performed the procedure had a very heavy hand. My teeth were very sensitive afterward. I've had teeth cleaning many times before and never experienced sensitivity. After the procedure, I had sensitivity for several weeks. During the procedure, they don't have you get up to rinse your mouth; they use a suction tube to remove debris and water. The debris flows down your throat, and the suction machine probably couldn't keep up. The dentist warned me not to swallow, but it overflowed my throat. In the end, I had to ask them to stop, and when I got up, I coughed and choked.
The reception staff and the doctor provided excellent service.

The clinic is very conveniently located. It's on a main road with easy access to the BTS Skytrain and a short taxi ride right in front of the clinic. The dentist is kind and gives excellent advice. The staff are lovely, caring, and friendly. I will definitely come back for more services if I have the opportunity.
The service is excellent, the prices are good, and the doctor is lovely and friendly. I've changed clinics before, but I always end up coming back here.

I brought my daughter to have her wisdom tooth extracted. The dentist was very gentle and kind. I highly recommend him/her.

It's very convenient to park at Lotus and walk there in 2 minutes.
Excellent service and advice. My teeth don't curve inwards after the braces are removed; they look beautiful! ☺️☺️
